name: Kalena Agrahara – Kadugodi Tree Park corridor
scope: 73 km proposed elevated corridor, over 50 stations, via Bannerghatta, Jigani and Sarjapur, with a 5 km spur to the international cricket stadium in Anekal taluk
pending: Feasibility study complete; proposal awaiting government review before Detailed Project Report (DPR) preparation, which officials estimate could take about a year. Construction has not been sanctioned and no cost figure has been published; reported potential construction start around 2029.
notes: Corporation set to South (Kalena Agrahara end) as a placeholder — the proposed route also runs through East Bengaluru and Anekal taluk, which lies outside the GBA area. This is the earliest-stage project tracked on this site: no sanction, no money_entry, no dated event — only a reported feasibility-study milestone (Asianet Newsable, 2026-05-09), which does not fit any event type in this site's schema and so is not recorded as a formal event row.
